_doc: Crafting numbers (gdd crafting v0.2 §4.4, §6, §17, §18): outcome thresholds on the margin m = competence - difficulty (+ noise), quality q_step = clamp(0.5 + k*m + noise), weights of tool/station/material knowledge/traits, quality tiers, recognition (tau, falloff of a numeric condition, improvised_min, effect_present), salvage share, experience, recipe book and breakthroughs; traits: per-trait modifiers (quality, speed, risk, xp, breakthrough).

worth._doc: AL-87: value components. Any def (material, shape, process, form, flaw) may carry "worth" (a multiplier, 1 = ordinary). An assembly blends its parts: parts_avg x mass average + parts_finest x the finest part. tags: worth carried by a tag wherever it shows (material tags, process marks, item tags). A made thing's worth multiplies its trade value (trade.json worth_exp).

magic._doc: AL-117 (LivelyRealms §7-§8): rune_min_conductivity: a carrier below it takes no rune; aspect_max: cap of an aspect effect; unstable_safe / blast_k: opposed aspects (aspects.json opposes, or + against - of one aspect) blow a step or a flask up with chance (unstable - safe) * blast_k * (1.2 - q); bind_cap_share: rune power <= carrier mana_capacity * share; rune_worth / resonance_worth: worth multipliers; resonance_deeds: deeds for resonance 1 - 1/e; resonance_rune: rune power grows with resonance; triggers: modes of bind; charge_per_use: share of the capacity one use spends.
